services.desc: All bait, tackle, ice, and bottled water will be provided on your South Padre Island fishing trip. Captain Mike Knox, our professional South Padre Island fishing guide, prefers to fish with light tackle spinning rods using artificial lures, cut bait, and/or live bait. Bay fishing in South Padre Island is a great place for kids and families to learn new fishing techniques and enjoy our great weather. Blast to Cast Guide Service will teach you how to catch fish while providing a fun and safe South Padre Island bay fishing charter experience.
